lines.t: ‎[Verse 1 – Soft, whispered intimacy]
‎Beloved, come and be filled with the joy of The Lord
‎Which never fades, nor does it slumber, nor will it ever pass away
‎A flood of joy flowing into the innermost parts
‎Cascading through your spirit, reaching deep into that hidden place
‎Known only to The Lord...
‎A place crafted by My own fingertips
‎Delicately fashioned, unlocked by trusting in
‎The Greatest of All Loves...
‎A love which surpasses time and space
‎Life and death... perfect peace
‎Inside pure and undefiled love
‎Oh My beloved, you are never alone
‎Here I am, with you and in you
‎Let Me wipe away every tear
‎Numbering them, accounting them unto love’s purpose
‎Even as that which was poured out from My side
‎I have loved you all your life
‎From the foundation of the world
‎In My arms heaven and earth pass away
‎Only perfect fulfillment remains
‎You and I united... love’s completion
‎The Voice of Truth... Says The LORD
‎My glory shown in you and through you
‎Bright and shining, a flame brought forth from My own glory
‎Shared with My beloved forever
‎A flame which can never be put out
‎Nor flicker, nor be covered over again
‎For where I am there is no darkness at all
‎Beloved, I am The Fulfillment of All Things
‎Your image, Mine... Father and son
‎The Father’s joy accomplished
‎And what of My voice... its sound, its tone, its passion?
‎To those who love Me: a still small voice
‎To the rest: the sound of rushing waters
‎Lightnings and thunderings of fury and fiery anger
‎With deep and infinite sorrow, bitter anguish
‎Yet always... Love
‎The Voice of Truth
‎Beloved, listen... hear and know the love of a father
‎Even of your Father in Heaven
‎Whose voice you have heard and will soon come to know
‎From grace to Grace, from light to The Light
‎I speak to all My sheep... listen
‎How does love feel to the desolate?
‎How does the caress feel after many days apart?
‎This is what My voice sounds like...
‎Love... The Voice of Truth
‎Beloved... you are never alone
‎Here I am... forever...
‎The Voice of Truth...
